story_type: litter hoist off a ship underway far offshore, color hoist camera, Alaska
hook: 160 miles from Kodiak, lifted off a moving ship.
narration: A hundred and sixty miles out from Kodiak, this rescue litter rose off the deck of a moving ship.
A twenty-two-year-old man aboard the Coastal Progress had a possible broken leg.
A Jayhawk crew from Air Station Kodiak flew out to meet the ship while it kept moving.
The rescue swimmer went down to the deck to get him ready for the lift.
A litter keeps a patient lying flat and strapped in, so a hurt leg never has to take any weight.
[short pause] Then the cable came tight, and the deck fell away below.
outcome: The Jayhawk crew hoisted him aboard and flew him to medical crews waiting in Kodiak.
title: Broken leg, 160 miles off Kodiak
description:
On June 19, 2017, a Coast Guard Air Station Kodiak MH-60 Jayhawk crew hoisted a 22-year-old man with a possible broken leg off the motor vessel Coastal Progress, 160 miles southwest of Kodiak, Alaska.
